title: DeepSeek V4 Just Dropped (And It's Wild)
description:
DeepSeek just dropped V4 and it might be the biggest AI release of the year. It scored 80.6 percent on SWE-Bench, tied with Claude Opus 4.7. 

It runs at one trillion parameters with a one million token context. The API is 7x cheaper than GPT-5.5 or Claude. 

And the real kicker, it's fully open source under MIT.
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
